script.problem: It has 39 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.
It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: “Spiritual goodness” may be hard for a 10-year-old to understand. Also, being blessed does not always mean feeling happy; it can mean being considered fortunate or approved.
“Mercies” may be hard for a 10-year-old to understand. “Kindness” would be plainer.
In Genesis 1:22, God blesses sea creatures and birds, but Meaning 1 only says God blesses people.
